failure_summary.description: Agents omitted requested refinements, repeated cached criteria, or added unsupported and unrelated filters or domain calls.
Agents invented missing hotel dates or failed to handle ready domains while requesting information for a blocked domain.
Agents imported or redefined tools, or omitted saving exact search or refinement results under new cache keys.
An affirmative reply to a concrete question about an additional attraction search was treated as requiring no action.

patch.reasoning: Most failures already contradict explicit cache, mandatory-input, and tool-use rules, so repeating those rules would not patch a skill gap. The uncovered ambiguity is whether an affirmative answer to a concrete yes/no question creates a new domain request; clarifying that interpretation addresses the distinct missed attraction search.

edits.target: A direct answer can also introduce a new destination, neighborhood, cuisine, amenity, or other criterion; it is not merely confirmation that an existing base result is adequate.
edits.content: An affirmative reply to a concrete yes/no question proposing an action in a supported travel domain makes that action a pending request, even if that domain was not previously active or other results are cached. Carry forward the named target or type and relevant location context, then search if mandatory inputs are available or request missing mandatory information. For example, “Are you interested in visiting any other guided attractions?” followed by “Yes” calls for an attraction search using the stated city and guided type.
